greeting: Atii, inuusiqaqtitauluta Atiup, Irniup, ammalu Anirniup Salumajuup aqqutitigut. Ataniq Jiisusi Kristusi, uummativut ammalu uummatikkut angiqtaugutiqarluta, ilagijaujut uummatikkut inuusiup qaumaninga.
penitential: Ataniq, nalligittigut. Kristusi, nalligittigut. Ataniq, nalligittigut.
homily:
Pitaqattarpuq inuusiup iluani, qanittumi, uqausiq uqumaittuq kisiani tusaajaujuq inuusiup iluani. Isumagilauruk una: ullaami, inuusiup qaujimajavut, inuusiup uqumaittuninga, kisiani takujavut inuusiup qaumaninga. Inuuqatigiinni, inuusiq una 'vineyard-tut' iluani, Ataniup vineyard-nga. 

Inuusiup vineyard-nga, taanna inuusiq, taanna inuusiq. Benjamin Vo, 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, inuusiqaqtilluni, inuit takulaurtangit silataani. Benjamin-up inuusia, taanna 'masterpiece-ngulluni', uummataup salumajunianik ammalu asijinik asujinik tatatitaulluni. Benjamin-up inuusia, taanna 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, inuit takulaurtangit silataani: silatualuuniranga, mathematics-mi pialuktuuninga, coding-mi ammalu technology-mi qaujimaninga. Taakkua pitsiaqtut, silataani qaumajut. Kisiani, Benjamin-up inuusia sanningajuup ujaqqatut tomb-tut ippunngilaq. Ben-up uummanga light-vallaalaurpuq, open-vallaalaurpuq, free-vallaalaurpuq. Ben-up uummanga walk-laurpuq Ataniup aqqutingitigut with a pure, simple heart.

'For my thoughts are not your thoughts, nor are your ways my ways, says the LORD.' Taanna Isaiah-up uqausinga, taanna uqausiq. Benjamin-up inuusia, taanna 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, inuusiqaqtilluni, inuit takulaurtangit silataani. Taanna inuusiq, taanna inuusiq. Alan ammalu Thao, ilissi uqumaittumik cross-mik tigumiavusi. 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni Benjamin nuulaurmat, illu nipiqanngippallaarami uummammi aaniarnartuq saqqiqattarpuq. Issiarvik inuqanngittuq nirivingmi… Benjamin-up qunganninga, nipingalu tusaassaarutilimat illumi… Nallunngituugaluaq, qatanngutikka, uqumaittumi aaniarnirmi, uummavut qiaisinamat, taaqtuq isuma saqquqtisarpaa. Do not rush past the wound. The silence in the house is real. Kisiani, Jiisusiup nipinga uqaqpuq: 'The last will be first, and the first will be last.'

Ryan, my dear younger brother, Ben's best friend. You stood beside Ben in front of the cockpit display at the museum; you sat beside him on the bench at the laundromat; you stood beside him outside Phở 54 in your scout uniforms. Ryan, Ben loved you with all his heart. You were his partner in adventure, his brother, his daily companion. When you miss him, when the house feels too quiet, remember that Ben's mind and heart were deeply bonded to yours. You carry Ben's memory inside you. Live your life fully, Ryan! Study hard, play, laugh, explore tech or aviation or whatever brings you joy, knowing that your big brother Ben is cheering you on from heaven's best vantage point. 

To all aunts, uncles, grandparents, cousins, and friends who loved Benjamin: Ben's life illuminated what it means to be truly wise. He was brilliant in math and computer logic, yet he was humble, respectful, and sweet-natured. He showed us that real intelligence is never loud or boastful; real intelligence is gentle, generous, and full of love. Benjamin’s life was a gift, a reflection of the Light that came into the world through Mary. He was a boy who looked at the world with wonder, a boy who built games and dreamed of 'con chim airlines', a boy who offered his piggy bank to help his uncle. These are not just memories; they are the fruits of a life lived in the grace of God.

To everyone tuning in from afar—especially families who are carrying heavy crosses, parents who grieve, and children who are suffering in hospitals or homes: You are seen by God. The Gospel reminds us today that Jesus' authority is not a heavy hand that crushes us, but a loving hand that heals, sets free, and restores. The Lord is just in all His ways, gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and full of great kindness. He lifts up all who are falling and raises up all who are bowed down.

Benjamin Vo is now in that Banquet, standing beside Saint Carlo Acutis. Two brilliant, modern boys who loved technology, who loved the world, but who loved God more. They are not dead; they are more alive than we are. They are soaring in the light of the Father, free from all weight, breathing the pure air of heaven. Ben's legacy continues to flow on earth, like the clean, life-sustaining water from the 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' well dedicated in his name in Cà Mau, Vietnam. His middle name, Đại Dương—Great Ocean—remains a sign of God's limitless mercy flowing to those in need.

What can we carry out the door today? Today, when you encounter a complex problem, or when your heart feels overwhelmed by sadness, take a slow breath and remember Saint Paul's words: 'For to me life is Christ, and death is gain.' Stop seeking answers only in human logic or earthly worry. Turn your mind to Jesus. Look up at the sky, just like Ben loved to watch airplanes soar into the clouds, and remember that God's authority is peace, God's Word is love, and Benjamin Vo is safe in the Father's eternal embrace. Let us pray: 'Lord Jesus Christ, You spoke with authority in the synagogue and brought peace to the hearts of all. Grant us the mind of Christ, that we may see beyond earthly tears into the eternal light of Your Kingdom. Comfort Alan, Thao, and Ryan with Your deep peace. Hold Benjamin Đại Dương Vo close in Your heavenly joy until we all meet again at Your eternal Banquet. Amen.'
spiritual_communion: Jiisusi, uummativut ilingnut, qaujimajavut ilvit qanittuviit. Uummativut ilingnut, Jiisusi. Amen.
closing: Ataniq Jiisusi Kristusi, uummativut ilingnut. Amen.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo ammalu tamaita tuqungajut, Ataniup qaumaningani nunaqaqtitaulutik.
Tamaita uqumaittumik aaniarniqtuut, Ataniup nalligittigut ammalu niriunniqtaulutik.

readings.label: Isaiah 55:6-9
readings.text: Ataniq qinirlugu qanittuqauppat, uqautilugu qanittuqauppat. Inuk ajungittuq, inuusiup aqqutingitigut utiqtitauluni; uummatikkut Ataniup nalligittigut. Ataniup isumangit ilipsit isumangit saniani, silaup qulaani nunamit, taanna Ataniup isumangit.

readings.label: Psalm 145:2-3, 8-9, 17-18
readings.text: Ataniq qanittuuq tamainnut uqautijunut ilingnut. Ataniq nalligittuq ammalu asijinik asujinik tatatitaulluni. Ataniq qanittuuq tamainnut uqautijunut ilingnut.

readings.label: Philippians 1:20c-24, 27a
readings.text: Kristusi inuusiup iluani, inuusiq Kristusi, tuquq 'gain'. Inuusiq inuusiup iluani, inuusiq Kristusi. Conduct yourselves in a way worthy of the gospel of Christ.

readings.label: Matthew 20:1-16a
readings.text: Jiisusi uqaqpuq: 'Kingdom of heaven-nga landowner-tut, vineyard-mi. Last will be first, and the first will be last.'

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
